title: The Legend of Oasis
subtitle: Before the golden armlet changed hands
summary: The Legend of Oasis is Ancient's action role-playing adventure, first released for Saturn in Japan on 26 April 1996.
body: The Legend of Oasis is Ancient's action role-playing adventure, first released for Saturn in Japan on 26 April 1996. Known as The Story of Thor 2 in Europe, it takes place before Beyond Oasis and follows Leon, a pupil entrusted with the Golden Armlet. He must gain the loyalty of six elemental spirits and oppose Agito, the bearer of the Silver Armlet. Direct fighting and environmental puzzles share an overhead world, with the spirits providing the abilities that gradually turn its barriers into routes through the adventure.

Leon summons a spirit by sending a Spirit Ball towards an object, with the object determining which companion appears. Water, fire, earth, sound, darkness and air each have their own spirit and practical uses. A companion may fight, heal Leon or help solve a puzzle, so noticing the surroundings becomes part of choosing what to summon. The expanded group builds on the earlier game's central idea: an elemental ability belongs to the landscape as well as the hero, and finding the correct place to call it is part of the solution.

Short swords, long swords and bows provide different attacks, with directional and button combinations producing special moves. Arrows can also activate switches, making equipment useful beyond an immediate enemy. This combination encourages the player to approach a room as both a fighting space and a small mechanical problem. Yuzo Koshiro produced the game and composed its music, with Ayano Koshiro contributing its art. The sharper Saturn presentation gives Leon's movements and surroundings greater detail while preserving the close connection between physical action, summoned companions and obstacles that defined the earlier adventure.
